summary.text: Timothy Wyatt is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Timothy Wyatt was a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives in Hillsborough District 38 in 2022 and in Hillsborough District 13 in 2024.
In 2022 Republican incumbents Tony Lekas and Alicia Lekas won the two seats in Hillsborough 38, and in 2024 Republican candidates won all six seats in Hillsborough 13.
In 2026 he advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 14, where Republican incumbent Sharon Carson also advanced from her primary.
